title: Evidence of Digital Citizenship
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting evidence of digital citizenship to digital citizenship evidence portfolio, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Map a chosen artifact to a specific digital-citizenship competency.
Write a caption that states which skill the artifact demonstrates and how.
Add a before-after note that shows growth, not just a finished state.
Curate: choose the few strongest pieces of evidence rather than collecting everything.
